title: Model estimates now use your Pollen balance
summary:
Balance-based image estimates arrived in the dashboard, three model routes were adjusted, and the website got a tidy-up.

The dashboard’s pricing table now estimates how many images a signed-in user can make with each model based on their balance. Models with less than one estimated request show 0 and a top-up explanation; signed-out visitors still see an approximate one-Pollen estimate.

DeepSeek and Kimi moved to different backends without changing their public model names. `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` moved to Vertex’s global endpoint to reduce region-specific 429 errors.

Website heading sizes were restored and the Play subtitle was brought into line with other pages. The app catalog received updated metrics and health checks, while the README refreshed Recent Apps credits and links.

highlights.title: Estimates for your balance
highlights.text: Sign in to see how many images your Pollen balance is estimated to cover for each model, rather than a generic one-Pollen example. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
